waukegan.notes: Home port. Waukegan Harbor & Marina 847-244-3133. Station 45186 (Waukegan Buoy) replaces 45007, which is not in NDBC's active station list as of 2026-07 - V-2.

north_point.notes: Winthrop Harbor bail-out; boundary Waukegan/Kenosha legs. Station 45187 (Winthrop Harbor Buoy) added - V-2.

kenosha.notes: Southport Marina 262-657-5565; office closed Sun/Mon. KNSW3 (Kenosha Light) is registered with NDBC but does not report meteorological data (met=n, no realtime2 feed); 45199 (Salmon Unlimited WI buoy, ~9nm N near Racine) is the nearest reporting station - V-2.

racine.notes: Reefpoint Marina 262-633-7171; Wind Point Light just north. 45199 (Salmon Unlimited WI buoy) replaces non-reporting KNSW3 - V-2.

milwaukee.notes: Lakeshore State Park Marina (no water/showers; elec incl; dockmaster 414-274-4281) / McKinley Marina (full service, fuel). 45013 (Atwater Park buoy) replaces 45007, which is not in NDBC's active station list as of 2026-07 - V-2.

chicago.notes: DuSable Harbor, transient via Dockwa. CNII2 (Northerly Isle, ~2nm) and CHII2 (Harrison-Dever Crib) both confirmed reporting - V-2. NDBC station IDs are case-sensitive in the realtime2 URL; must be uppercase.

thresholds.status: Kent's limits (adopted 2026-10-11). Guests only in green; yellow is crew-only.
thresholds.notes: Lake Michigan builds short, steep wind waves fast; limits are much lower than open-ocean ones for the same wave height.

offshore.notes: NHC Offshore Waters Forecast (OFFNT3). AMZ051 = Offshore Waters Leeward Islands. No NWS coastal (CWF) zones or NWS point/gridpoint coverage exist here - forecasts come from Open-Meteo.

antigua_barbuda.buoy_notes: 42060 (Caribbean Valley, ~100nm WSW of Antigua) and 41043 (NE of Puerto Rico) both confirmed reporting 2026-10-11. Neither is upwind of Antigua; treat as regional context, not local truth.

english_harbour.notes: Moorings base (charter start/end). Approximate position for weather lookups only - not for navigation.

falmouth_harbour.notes: Adjacent to English Harbour. Approximate position.

deep_bay.notes: West coast; Andes wreck, Fort Barrington. Approximate position.

great_bird_island.notes: North Sound staging point for Barbuda. Moorings/Sunsail list North Sound to Nonsuch Bay (NE coast) as reef-restricted - confirm at briefing. Approximate position.

green_island.notes: Nonsuch Bay / Green Island, east coast; reef entrance needs good light. Approximate position.

antigua_barbuda_channel.notes: Mid-channel reference point for the open-water crossing. Not an anchorage.

barbuda_low_bay.notes: West coast, Codrington Lagoon/frigate birds. Exposed to N/W swell. No nav aids; charts unreliable. Approximate position.

barbuda_cocoa_point.notes: SW Barbuda; better shelter from N swell than Low Bay. Approximate position.

thresholds.status: Kent's limits (adopted 2026-10-11). Guests only in green; yellow is crew-only. Cloud cover matters here for reading reef depth.
thresholds.notes: Open-ocean trade-wind sailing on a 42ft monohull, two experienced crew.

advisories.message: Northerly swell - Barbuda west-coast anchorages (Low Bay) may be uncomfortable or untenable; Cocoa Point/Gravenor Bay are better sheltered; dinghy landings may surf.
